remarks: Fresh and appealing condition in this 3 bedroom, 2 full bath ranch style unit which includes a two car detached garage. There is a full staircase from the ground level mud room/laundry room entry up into the unit. Open concept living area. Kitchen with granite counters, stainless appliances and breakfast bar. Two newer baths. Fresh paint and hardwood floors throughout. All 3 bedrooms have newer custom shades. Gas heat and hot water. Gas approximately $65.00 per month, electric approximately $154 per month. Water and sewer included in monthly rental. Walk up attic for storage only. Excellent credit a must with verification of employment and verification of income. An easy walk to the CT Transit stop and the Glenbrook train station.

facts.petsInfo: one cat or one small dog
